checkpoint.gameMemory: Unsaved game memory excluded; no game input, settings mutation or foreground control

scenario.scope: Actual owned registration/visibility/runtime toggles + pinned native driver code; widgets/macro parser/trusted dispatch modeled. Not native combat, mouse routing or taint proof.
scenario.sequence: Five client contracts; present focus->combat clear->combat set->dead focus->20clear/set cycles->disable->event tick->reenable;20stable setting requests.
scenario.warmup: One excluded pair; five alternating baseline/candidate pairs
scenario.profiling: None. Native CPU/allocation/latency/frame-time/hardware/settings/addon-list-matched performance unavailable; no preference changes.
scenario.resources: Existing native state manager and repaired-handler probe reused. No new timers/events/OnUpdates/caches/native API overrides. Bounded2visibility registrations; stable20requests add none. Full frame counts unchanged in replay.
scenario.interpretation: Baseline alpha-zero focus retains combat hit region in Forever, dead focus target leaks on all modeled clients, and disabled watchers resurrect. Candidate is real-hidden by native state ownership; prepared clicks return on combat focus gain. No FPS/CPU improvement claim.
